Important note about your requested nightly tag format
- Exact git tag text like Nightly – DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM am/pm is not valid as a git tag (slashes, colon, and spaces break git ref rules).
- I implemented:
  - Nightly git tag: nightly-YYYYMMDD-HHMM
  - Nightly release title: Nightly – DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM AM/PM UTC
- This preserves compatibility and still gives you the human-readable nightly label you wanted on the GitHub Release page.

How to use it
1. Open Actions → Release workflow → Run workflow.
2. Set Release type:
- official: same behavior as before, uses bump (major/minor/patch), tag is Vx.y.z.
- nightly: creates nightly tag/title, marks release as prerelease. Bump is ignored.
